method: Initial read-only source audit followed by root-authorized changes to only the final Python assembler and immutable review snapshots. Pure-function synthetic validation and py_compile executed; finalization, browser, database and canonical PASS generation not executed.
safeGuards: Candidate requires actual pnpm test:e2e command exit0/PASS and matching runId
Discovery actual count at least219 and exact executed expected count
Test source unchanged during actual execution
Required UX contexts and10numericmetrics, raw source SHA checked
External gates remain separately blocked; no full acceptance while privacy review missing

findings.actual: Finalizer reads missingMeasuredFields; current aggregator records missingMeasuredOrDescriptiveFields. No explicit adapter exists in inspected files.
findings.required: Use the current named field or explicitly normalize with provenance before validation. Do not fabricate missing counts.
findings.resolution: Strict validate_ux_measurement_shape requires missingMeasuredOrDescriptiveFields as an empty list. No legacy-key fallback; all ten metrics must exist and be finite nonnegative numeric values excluding booleans. Empty steps require all action counts including repeated fields to be zero.

findings.actual: Finalizer overwrites EXTERNAL_GATES.json after candidate and ROOT_GATES_REVIEW bind its pre-publication SHA.
findings.required: Preserve the reviewed immutable source or recompute all affected bindings consistently. Do not retain stale SHA for a changed file.
findings.resolution: EXTERNAL_GATES_REVIEWED.json is byte-identical to the original reviewed gate file. ROOT_GATES_FINAL_REVIEW.json binds that snapshot and unchanged two packets. Assembler validates exact bytes and FINAL_FACTS object equality before any canonical output; final EXTERNAL_GATES envelope adds LOCAL_ACCEPTED and preserves the three external objects unchanged. Candidate remaps historical gate/review paths before hashing, so snapshot hashes remain valid.

invocationNotes.batchRun: Set LMS_UX_BATCH_RUN to the same full run if claiming fresh full-run batch measurements; otherwise label prior targeted proof explicitly.
invocationNotes.currentRun: Set LMS_UX_CURRENT_RUN to the final completed run

unchangedBoundaries: Optional teacher scope remains conditional, not an implemented positive role claim.
Unsigned ordinary documents retain registry/QR denial.
Electronic-original success is not claimed without real signatures.
First-entry/setup/other-role/authentication costs stay separate from prepared business-action budgets.
